comments.subject: Public Comments
comments.comment: With summer months coming up could you please activate the ability to sign up for tee times sooner than 6:00AM. Soon we will need to be at the course early and won't have access to a computer. If you must stay with the two week rule to sign up please activate at midnight instead of 6:00. We can still be in the two week rule, but can set tee time before having to be at the course in the summer months. Thanks for listening. Please call if my note is not clear.

notes: Single-page submission via the city public-comments web form. Personal info redacted. OCR '6:OOAM' corrected to '6:00AM'.
